```{r}
library("httr2")
url <- "https://api.ukhsa-dashboard.data.gov.uk/themes/infectious_disease/sub_themes/bloodstream_infection/topics/MRSA/geography_types/Nation/geographies/England/metrics/MRSA_cases_countsByOnsetTypeByMonth"
url <- paste0(url, "?page_size=365")
print(url)

api_request <- request(url)
response <- req_perform(api_request)
json_response <- resp_body_json(response)

str(json_response, max.level = 1)

result_df <- bind_rows(json_response$results)
gt(head(result_df))

print(unique(pull(result_df, stratum)))
print(unique(pull(result_df, sex)))
print(unique(pull(result_df, age)))
# check whether any of these columns contain more than one value:

filt <- filter(result_df, stratum == "Total cases")
gt(filt)

```
